item.title: No plan, no peace
item.description: No plan, no peace. This is where the US-Israeli war on Iran stands. This state of affairs has profound implications for the global order. US military force has reached an important limit. Today, military might does not ensure domination, particularly when there is no coherent strategy. CrossTalking with Stanley L. Cohen and Raed Jarrar.

item.title: Energy shock
item.description: The energy shock the entire world is experiencing is not going away anytime soon. What happens if the Persian Gulf does not stay there? How is this energy shock different from the past and have the international energy markets been forever changed? CrossTalking with Michael Hudson and Radhika Desai.

item.title: RT’s Peter Lavelle interviews Dennis Kucinich: Evolution or breakdown?
item.description: Why is it that the US no longer has the capacity to win wars? Western publics are universally against war, but their elites are not. Who is behind these elites? Are forever wars now the norm, and not the exception?

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Houthi warpath
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis are on the march in a big way. Meanwhile, the US-Israeli war with Iran is expanding. Is this other front changing the geopolitical landscape of the Middle East? Also, could the AfD’s electoral victory in Germany affect the politics of all Europe? CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: Ukraine’s coming endgame
item.description: By just about every metric, Ukraine is on the ropes. From the lack of adequate air defenses, growing budget holes, and crippling corruption, to the shortage of manpower on the front, the Kiev regime’s prospects are grim. At the very least, this is the end of the beginning. In the meantime, Europe wants Ukraine to fight to the last Ukrainian. CrossTalking with James Jatras, Mats Nilsson, and Marko Gasic.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns | Global energy crisis
item.description: A global energy crisis is here. Saudi oil has stopped going to Europe. There is a mounting diesel crisis in the US. Petroleum prices are climbing. And the war of choice against Iran is far from over. Also, are we facing an AI apocalypse? It depends on who you ask. CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.

item.title: RT’s Peter Lavelle interviews Roger Waters: Frontman to activist
item.description: For countless people, Roger Waters is the frontman of the iconic rock band Pink Floyd – music that has become part of the fabric of our contemporary cultural life. Waters is also a high-profile human rights campaigner who advocates for the fair treatment of Palestinians. He has taken a moral position and should be an inspiration for the rest of us.

item.title: Expanding war
item.description: The US-Israeli war on Iran was supposed to be quick and easy. Instead, seven months later, the war is far from over and expanding. Not long ago, the Axis of Resistance was written off as defeated. That was premature. This war of choice has inflamed the entire region. CrossTalking with Joshua Landis and Patrick Henningsen.
